message1: Ikhodi yelulwimi ayisebenti. Sebentisa id, si, ja, zh-CN, njalonjalo.
message5: — Imikhawulo yekufuna/yekulinganisa. Yetama futsi ngemuva kwesikhatsi.
message6: Umhlinzeki akabuyiseli emahumusho. Hlola imodeli, lulwimi, kanye ne-quota.
message8: I batch ayisebenti noma inkulu kakhulu.
message12: Umbhalo longenalutfo nobe tinhlavu letingetulu kwa-12 000.
message34: Umhlinzeki ushintja indlela yekumaka. Ibhulokhi yekucala iyagcinwa.
message38: Emamaki alahlekile emiphumeleni. Ibhulokhi yekucala iyagcinwa.
message44: Umhlinzeki wehlulekile ngemacembu lamatsatfu. Chafata kuhumusha kute uphindze uzame.
message49: Umkhawulo wememori yekucuketfwe ufinyelelwe. Buyisela lelikhasi ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.
message50: Humusha emakhasi ngemshini wakamuva kanye nelulwimi
message58: Layisha kabusha lesandziso bese uvuselela lelikhasi kute ulayishe lengucuko lensha.
message61: Vuselela lelikhasi uma kuvuselelwa seluleko lesisha.
